text:
Sam (on-call): seeing a sudden spike in 5xxs from the inference canary at ~12:01 UTC. /v1/generate error rate jumped to ~40% on canary-2. Anybody touching deploys? :warning:

deploy-bot: canary rollout started: release/4387 -> cluster=canary-2 image=registry.internal/redwood/inference:nightly-20260108 (triggered by pipeline 4387)

Priya (releases): that was me — pipeline 4387 finished and pushed 'nightly' tag. we usually rely on immutable sha tags but this pipeline uses the nightly tag for fast iteration. did the manifest change?

Lukas (infra): I see a manifest mismatch in the registry. pipeline 4387 pushed image with digest sha256:abcd1234 but another push later replaced the 'nightly' tag pointing to sha256:deadbeef. looks like a race where two jobs published the same tag. here's what the registry returned: ```
GET /v2/redwood/inference/manifests/nightly -> digest: sha256:deadbeef
expected digest: sha256:abcd1234
```

Marta (sre): incident-bot, create SEV2 page and notify cc: infra, releases, oncall. Customer impact: routing canaries were used for 10% of traffic for a subset of customers (alpha program). Starting triage now.

incident-bot: SEV2 Incident created (INC-2026-0123). Pages sent to Sam (on-call), Marta (sre).

Sam (on-call): confirmed. grabbing logs and metrics. If the 'nightly' tag was swapped we should kill the canary routing immediately and rollback the pods to stable sha. Priya, can you hold any new publish to 'nightly'?

Priya (releases): pausing pipelines that push 'nightly' now. creating a temporary queue.

Sam (on-call): executing kill-switch to route traffic to stable pool. command: ```bash
# flip feature flag to disable canary routing
redwood-cli ff toggle canary_routing --env prod --off
# or via api
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/flags/canary_routing -d '{"enabled":false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```

deploy-bot: applied feature flag change; traffic routing updated, all new requests bypass canary-2.

Sam (on-call): rolling back canary-2 to immutable sha256:abcd1234 (the build we expected). kubectl set image deployment/inference-canary registry.internal/redwood/inference@sha256:abcd1234 -n canary-2

deploy-bot: rollback initiated. pods terminating... starting new pods with sha256:abcd1234. health checks passing on 2/3, 3/3, 5/5.

Lukas (infra): dug into CI logs. There's a race in our release job: if a retry happens after a promotion step completes, the job republishes the same tag. Adding an atomic tag check to the pipeline: fail if tag already exists and does not match expected digest. Draft PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/1298 (adds pre-push manifest check).

Marta (sre): customer-impact summary: three alpha customers hit 500s for ~3 minutes while traffic was routed to the bad canary image. support notified and on a call with customer A now. posting on status page: "Partial failures for alpha routing; rollback in progress".

Priya (releases): confirmed rollback completed. I'm adding a pipeline guard to prefer pushing SHA-tagged images (e.g., inference@sha256:...) and have nightly be a mirror only, not used by routing. Follow-up PRs coming.

Sam (on-call): good job. leaving a note for handoff to Priya and Lukas at 14:00 UTC for postmortem and longfix. For now traffic stable.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-0123 logged. Jira ticket created: RED-INC-2026-0123.

Priya (releases): action items I will own: 1) stop mutable nightly as a routing tag, 2) update publish job to always push sha and create mirror tag only, 3) add pre-push registry manifest verification. PRs: https://git.internal/redwood/releases/pulls/210, https://git.internal/redwood/releases/pulls/211

Lukas (infra): action items: 1) add registry hook to reject mutable overrides for protected tags, 2) add alert if digest differs between pipeline expected and registry returned, 3) add test in CI simulating concurrent pushes. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/1298

Marta (sre): action: coordinate customer follow-ups with support and update postmortem template. prepping initial blameless postmortem draft.

Sam (on-call): handing off to Priya for postmortem. leaving the thread open for updates. :thumbsup:
